text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Vitamin D supplementation corrects deficiency and improves bone mineral density in adults with low serum vitamin D levels.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Daily vitamin D supplementation in vitamin D deficient populations improves muscle strength and reduces falls.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#3"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A meta-analysis reports a modest fracture benefit in older adults when vitamin D is combined with calcium over sustained daily use.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#1"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A Cochrane review found no reduction in all-cause mortality from vitamin D supplementation in adults who are not deficient at baseline.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"The VITAL trial of about 25,000 participants found no significant effect of vitamin D on cardiovascular events or cancer.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#4"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Routine vitamin D supplementation in adults with adequate serum levels showed no measurable outcome improvement.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#6"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"High-dose vitamin D has been linked to hypercalcaemia and, in some trials, to increased fall risk in older adults.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#7"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Observational links between vitamin D and immune benefit are associational only.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#2"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Routine daily vitamin D supplementation is justified mainly for deficient adults rather than for all adults.","cited_pids":[]}]}
